Finding 1: the main battlefield of the residual slip is the handover apportioning segment, concentrated in the stiffest legs L1/R1 and growing round by round — reproduced in all three replicates.
Group B L1 handover segment per round: #1 6.8→10.3→12.6, #2 6.9→8.6→10.6, #3 6.7→8.8→11.9 mm (R1 similar, 6.6–11.4); the other four legs ≈0–1.5 mm. <b>发现 1:残余下滑主战场从破裂瞬间转移到交接铺设段,且集中在最硬的两条腿。:
Finding 1: the main battlefield of the residual slip moves from the rupture instant to the handover apportioning segment, concentrated in the two stiffest legs.
Group B L1 handover-segment displacement grows round by round 6.8→10.3→12.6 mm (climbing with the steady-state stored energy), R1 6.6→8.2→10.2; the other four legs ≈0–1.5 mm. Mechanism: "six-leg command mean unchanged ⇒ body does not move" only holds when all six legs have equal stiffness; the elastic equilibrium is a stiffness-weighted average, so moving load from the stiffest L1/R1 (bounce-vs-δ slopes 0.57/0.39, the largest of all) to the five softer legs necessarily sinks the body. Weights (C) cut this segment by 27% (60.7→44.3 mm).
Engineering meaning: a next-generation "stiffness-aware share" — solving Σk·d=0 for each stance leg's received share — could bring the handover-segment displacement to zero, corresponding to about 57–62% headroom on the B/C residual slip; it is also the experimental basis for the paper's three-generation story "equal split → rotation weights → stiffness-aware".

<b>TL;DR</b>：零前进指令下，机器人每轮（6 腿各抬落一次）沿墙下滑\: TL;DR: with zero forward command, the robot slides down the wall 57 → 74 mm per round (each of 6 legs lifted and landed once), 131 mm over two rounds, with zero cup slip and zero drift at rest throughout. Frame-by-frame decomposition: 83% of the slip happens in the instant the vented seal ruptures (an elastic bounce of <100 ms; during the 0.4 s of pressure release after the valve opens the body does not move at all) — hard proof of the ratchet mechanism "elastic energy stored in the lifted leg is released at the moment of detachment, the body drops, and the next attachment locks it in". The press landing accounts for only 4%. The front (upper) legs have the largest single bounces: L1 up to 20.9 mm, R1 up to 19.2 mm. Total servo current climbs ratchet-like from 0.73 A to ~1.9 A: internal stress between legs accumulates cycle by cycle, the servos are fighting each other. Direction of the remedy: a "zero-force handover" before venting (first hand the lifted leg's stored command over to the other five legs, vent only once force ≈ 0); slow venting does not help (the data show no motion during pressure release; the jump is entirely at the rupture instant).

六足爬壁机器人 · 排查案卷 · 2026-09-02 至 09-04: Hexapod wall-climbing robot · troubleshooting case file · 2026-09-02 to 09-04
树莓派 5 在舵机继电器合闸的一瞬间概率性断电死机。三天里从\"阀线圈\"查到\: The Raspberry Pi 5 would randomly lose power and die at the instant the servo relay closed. Over three days the suspicion moved from "valve coils" to "5 V margin" to "18 servos drawing a big current", and was finally settled by a log line 14 milliseconds long and one USB cable. This case file records the detours, the tools that actually worked, and the lessons worth carrying to the next project.
<span>机器：<b>Pi 5 + Servo2040 + 18 舵机 + 六: Machine: Pi 5 + Servo2040 + 18 servos + six valves Power: 2S LiPo → 5 V buck for the Pi; relay switches the servo positive Symptom: status LED green → solid red, SSH drops, needs a power cycle
继电器合闸时的充电脉冲经 USB 地线灌进 Pi，PMIC 判欠压断电: The charging pulse at relay closure floods into the Pi through the USB ground, and the PMIC calls it undervoltage and cuts power
同一次开机只拔一根 USB 线：拔掉合闸十次 0x0，插回第一次 0x50000: Same boot, only one USB cable changed: unplugged, ten closures all 0x0; plugged back in, the first closure gives 0x50000
USB 隔离器；舵机轨预充软启动；星形接地: USB isolator; pre-charge soft start of the servo rail; star grounding
启动脚本先把六个电磁阀线圈逐一通电到排气位，然后合舵机继电器。有一定概率就在这段: The startup script first energizes the six solenoid valve coils one by one into the exhaust position, then closes the servo relay. With some probability the Raspberry Pi dies right in this window: solid red LED, green LED off, SSH unreachable, only a power cycle helps. On the Pi 5 this LED state is the halted state after the PMIC has cut power to the processor, the same as after sudo halt.

The only tools were a multimeter, the Pi's own PMIC readout (vcgencmd pmic_read_adc, which in practice runs at 10 Hz) and the kernel log. 合闸脉冲经 USB 地线进入树莓派的电流路径: Current path of the closure pulse entering the Raspberry Pi through the USB ground
舵机回流地 · 几十安 · 百微秒: Servo return ground · tens of amps · hundreds of µs
地线把两块板连通: Ground wire ties the two boards together
一部分脉冲改走 USB 地 → Pi 地平面 → GND 杜邦线 → R050: Part of the pulse detours: USB ground → Pi ground plane → GND Dupont wire → R050 → battery negative
杜邦线和 R050 上的压降，在 PMIC 眼里就是 5V 跌落。跌浅留粘滞位，: The drop across the Dupont wire and R050 looks like a 5 V dip to the PMIC. A shallow dip leaves a sticky bit; a deep one gives the red LED.
触点闭合的一瞬间，电池对 18 个舵机和 Servo2040 的电容充电，峰值几: At the instant the contacts close, the battery charges the capacitance of 18 servos and the Servo2040: peaks of tens of amps lasting hundreds of microseconds, with a few extra hits from contact bounce. This current creates a momentary voltage difference along the servo return ground, lifting the Servo2040's ground. The USB cable ties the Servo2040 ground to the Pi ground, so part of the pulse detours through the Pi. The diagram colors are fixed and independent of the page theme.
降压模块的绿灯是旁证: The buck module's green LED is corroborating evidence
新换的模块是 XL4015 5A 恒流恒压板，背面丝印写着红灯恒流、蓝灯充电、绿: The new module is an XL4015 5 A constant-current/constant-voltage board; the silkscreen on the back says red = constant current, blue = charging, green = full. The sense resistor R10 is 50 mΩ, in series between OUT− and IN−, i.e. between the Pi's ground and the battery negative; the output voltage is regulated against IN−, so any current through it is subtracted directly from the 5 V the Pi sees. The blue LED flashing green at closure means the current comparator saw the output current drop to near zero or even reverse, which can only be an external pulse passing through it. The old fixed 5 V module had no such resistor and the crash happened anyway, so it is not the root cause, just an amplifier of the dip.

journal 戛然而止无 Oops；power_reset=2 是 PMIC: Journal stops abruptly with no Oops; power_reset=2 is a PMIC power cut; the hardware watchdog could not save it either
根因是继电器合闸瞬间对舵机侧电容充电的脉冲，经 Pi 与 Servo2040 之: The root cause is the pulse that charges the servo-side capacitance at the instant the relay closes; it floods into the Raspberry Pi through the USB ground between the Pi and the Servo2040, and the drop it produces across the GND Dupont wire and the sense resistor is judged by the PMIC as input undervoltage. A shallow dip leaves only a sticky bit; a deep one makes the PMIC cut power, shown as the solid red LED.
<b>USB 隔离器。</b>ADuM3160 一类的全速隔离器，12 Mbps: USB isolator. A full-speed isolator such as the ADuM3160; 12 Mbps is enough for the Servo2040 serial link. Inserted between the Pi and the Servo2040, it physically breaks the ground loop. The cleanest cut.
<b>舵机轨预充软启动。</b>第二只小继电器串 4.7 Ω 5 W 电阻先合: Pre-charge soft start of the servo rail. A second small relay in series with a 4.7 Ω 5 W resistor closes first for 100 ms to charge the capacitance, then the main relay closes; or swap in a P-MOS soft-start module. It can be verified first by manually pre-charging through a 10 Ω resistor across the contacts for a second before closing and watching the sticky bit.
<b>星形接地。</b>Servo2040 的 GND 和降压模块的 IN− 各: Star grounding. The Servo2040 GND and the buck module's IN− each run in short thick wire straight to the same point on the battery negative; no Dupont wire for the Pi's 5V/GND. This only mitigates; it does not break the path.
Pi 5V 针脚上并电容只治标：按 Pi 5 约 0.7 A 算，2200 µF: A capacitor across the Pi's 5 V pins only treats the symptom: at the Pi 5's ~0.7 A, 2200 µF holds a 0.4 V dip for about 1 ms. The XL4015's R050 can be bridged with solder so that OUT− equals IN− directly; the module degrades into a plain regulator and the LEDs stop working, which is fine. Once the path is broken it is harmless by itself and can be left alone.

<b class=\"d\">结论：即便只剩一台泵，也不要合成一块。</b>XL: Conclusion: even with only one pump, do not merge onto one module. The XL6009's current limit is on the input side (switch and inductor sit in the input loop); the chip's switch current limit is 4 A peak, and the inductor ripple stacks on top of the mean; the SS34 on the module is a 3 A part and the small inductor typically saturates at 3–4 A. Against the table: at nominal voltage the steady 3.2 A is already at the limit, in the second half of the battery it is over, and the pump start-up will hit current limiting and hiccup. The "3 A" in the BOM is the module's nominal input rating, not its 12 V output capability — boosting 7.4 V to 12 V, that corresponds to only about 1.5 A of output. With separate rails the pump rail carries 0.8 A and the valve rail 0.9 A, both easy.
<b>合轨塌陷的失效方向</b>（此处旧版写反了，一并更正）：本项目的阀是常闭、: Failure direction of a shared-rail collapse (the old version had this backwards; corrected here): this project's valves are normally closed, powered = vent (VALVE_ON_LEVEL=0 in adhesion.py), so an unpowered valve does not draw from this rail at all — a voltage dip cannot release a foot that is holding vacuum. The real failure chains are two: ① a venting valve drops out → the foot that should be released re-grips halfway while the gait state machine thinks it is free; lifting = tearing; ② while dropping out the valve is half-open and leaks air into the shared vacuum manifold, while the undervolted pump loses output → tank pressure rises → all six feet weaken together. ② is the path to "everyone loses suction". The conclusion that rails must be split stands, but this is the reasoning chain.
<b>单泵反而更该分轨，不是更不需要</b>：双泵时每台占空比低、启动次数少；单: A single pump needs the split more, not less: with two pumps each has a low duty cycle and starts rarely; a single pump must top up 6 feet + tank alone, its duty cycle rises and it starts more often, so the probability of a pump-start window overlapping a valve-action window goes up. "One pump fewer, so the rails can be merged" points the wrong way.

Whenever the servos move the battery terminal voltage dips, and the boost's input-current demand jumps at the same moment — the "second half 6.6 V" row in the table is this case, not something that appears only when the battery is drained.

这台机器有 18 个舵机，是全机数量最多、最贵、也最容易被误解的零件。\n: This machine has 18 servos: the most numerous, most expensive and most misunderstood part on the whole robot. A servo is not a "motor" — you do not give it a voltage, you give it an angle, and it closes the loop internally to get there. But that loop is sealed inside the case; the outside never sees the position. The program only ever knows "the command was sent", never whether the joint actually got there. More than half of the pitfalls hit while climbing grow out of that one sentence.
<span class=\"n\">1</span><span class=\": 1What is inside the case
一个标准舵机 = <strong>小直流电机 + 减速齿轮组 + 位置电位器 +: A standard servo = small DC motor + reduction gear train + position potentiometer + a control board, packed into a small box, with three wires out: power, ground, signal. The control board keeps comparing "the angle the signal wire asks for" with "the actual angle the potentiometer measures", drives the motor toward whichever side the error points, and stops when the error is about zero — a complete position loop, just inside the box.
信号线只把目标角度送进控制板；电位器的实际角度反馈只在壳内闭环，不会送回外部控制: The signal wire only carries the target angle into the control board; the potentiometer's actual-angle feedback closes the loop inside the case and never returns to the external controller.
壳内反馈：实际角度只回到控制板: In-case feedback: the actual angle returns only to the control board
外部控制器拿不到这个角度 —— 对树莓派来说，整条运动链是开环的: The external controller never gets this angle — to the Raspberry Pi the whole motion chain is open loop
橙色是命令流，蓝色虚线是反馈流。<strong>反馈流不出壳</strong>—: Orange is the command flow, blue dashed is the feedback flow. The feedback never leaves the case — this one figure explains half of the design decisions later in this project.
和别的\"会转的东西\"区别在哪: How it differs from other "things that turn"
转速，位置得自己加编码器: Speed; position needs your own encoder
开环角度，丢步不告诉你: Open-loop angle; lost steps go unreported
只有转动，没有任何回读: Motion only, no read-back of any kind
要力控或诊断的关节: Joints that need force control or diagnostics
信号线上是一串方波：<strong>每 20 毫秒来一个高电平脉冲</stron: The signal wire carries a square wave: one high pulse every 20 milliseconds; the width of the pulse sets where the horn stops. By industry convention 1500 µs is center and 1000/2000 µs are the usual ends; this project widens the range to 500–2500µs to use the full travel, with a measured slope of about 10 µs = 1°. The 20 ms gap between pulses does not mean "released" — as long as pulses keep coming, the servo keeps pushing against that angle.
20 ms 周期 · 脉宽已放大 4× 便于观察: 20 ms period · pulse width magnified 4× for visibility
拖动改变脉宽 · 500 ~ 2500 µs: Drag to change the pulse width · 500 – 2500 µs

关节角一栏用的是 L2 大腿舵机（通道 10）的实测标定：<code>attac: The joint-angle field uses the measured calibration of the L2 femur servo (channel 10): attach = 47.81° (at center the joint is actually at 47.8°, not 0°), servo's own ∓45° = 1952.5 / 1047.5 µs. On this channel a larger pulse width gives a smaller joint angle — left and right legs are mirror-assembled; the direction difference does not change the formula, it is absorbed into the two endpoints of the calibration table. Swap in a different servo and the same pulse width maps to a completely different joint angle, which is why all 18 channels must be calibrated individually. Also, the slider's 500–2500 µs is a software soft limit; the real mechanical travel is narrower, and going beyond it hits structure — the code has a separate joint-angle envelope check for that.

<span class=\"n\">6</span><span class=\": 6Servos misbehave: five behaviors under load
以下五条在数据手册上一条都找不到，但每一条都在这个项目里造成过实际后果。\n: None of the following five appears in any datasheet, yet each has caused real consequences in this project. Their common root is the figure in Section 1: you send a position, you get "roughly that position", and you have no way of knowing the difference.
一 · 让位角：带载时它停不到指令位置: One · Give: under load it does not stop at the commanded position
电机的保持力矩是有限的，外力越大，实际停的角度离指令越远——像一根很硬的弹簧，不: The motor's holding torque is finite; the larger the external force, the further the actual angle from the command — like a very stiff spring, not a rigid body. The most expensive appearance of this in the project: the foot preload travel is 13 mm by geometry, but on the real machine only a few mm went in, most of it eaten by "servo position error under load + backlash"; the default ended up at press_delta_mm = 18, trading command overshoot for real compression.
二 · 齿隙：反向时先空转一点: Two · Backlash: a little free play on reversal
金属齿轮组必然有间隙。同一个目标角，从上面过去和从下面过去，实际停的位置不一样。: A metal gear train always has clearance. For the same target angle, arriving from above and from below stops at different positions. This makes "return to the original position" inherently imprecise.
三 · 扭矩饱和：储能有上限: Three · Torque saturation: stored energy has a ceiling
实测单腿抬起时的弹性回弹最大约 21mm 就封顶了，再抬也不会更多——因为舵机扭:
Measured elastic rebound when lifting a single leg caps at about 21 mm; lifting more does not add — because servo torque tops out and no more energy can be stored.
    Bad news (the leg chain is being bent all the time) and good news (the ratchet effect has a ceiling, the machine does not slide down without bound).
四 · 它是弹簧，会存能量: Four · It is a spring and stores energy
舵机让位角 + 吸盘的橡胶变形 = 一根串联弹簧。抬腿前这根弹簧一直在存能，\n: Servo give + rubber deformation of the cup = one spring in series. Before a leg lifts, this spring keeps storing energy, released all at once the instant the cup's seal ruptures — measured 83% of the whole-robot slip happens in those 1–2 frames. The fix is not a stiffer servo but handing this leg's load to the other five before venting, so there is no energy left in the spring.
持续扛载的舵机会烫。判断有没有超出安全区的土办法：加深 3mm 预压后<stro: A servo holding load continuously gets hot. A rough way to judge whether it has left the safe zone: after adding 3 mm of preload, if the current increase is still gentle, no jump, no odd noise, not too hot to touch, then there is margin; a jump means it is already near the stall region.
<b>一条铁律：使能状态下永远不许用手掰关节。</b>\n 35kg·: One iron rule: never force a joint by hand while enabled. 35 kg·cm of stall torque is enough to break gears, and the angle you force is fake — let go and it turns itself back to the command. To adjust a pose, cut servo power first.

The full algorithm of the calibration table and a reproducible worked example are in the "From walking commands to 18 servos" illustrated page.

<span class=\"n\">8</span><span class=\": 8Power, power-up order and power-loss behavior
绝不和控制器共用电源轨: Never share a power rail with the controller
18 个舵机同时动，瞬态能拉到 12A，电压会明显往下掉。\n 如果树莓派: 18 servos moving together can pull 12 A transient, and the voltage dips visibly. If the Raspberry Pi and the servos share one supply, the Pi reboots at the instant a servo stalls — a reboot on the wall means a fall. This project: the 2S battery feeds the servos directly, a separate 5V/5A buck feeds the Pi, and the two share only ground.

So the correct order is set all 18 target pulse widths first, then close servo power — the firmware guarantees the enable instant lands directly in place, no wild jump. Whole-robot power-up has one more step: send the crouch pose first (closest to the unpowered lying pose, smallest jump), then transition slowly to standing.
断电 = 趴下，这是特性不是故障: Power loss = collapse; a feature, not a fault

18 个脉宽算好后,树莓派把它们打成<b>一个</b>串口包发给 Servo20: With the 18 pulse widths computed, the Raspberry Pi packs them into one serial packet for the Servo2040 driver board:
SET 包:命令字 0xD3 + 起始通道 + 数量 + 每个值拆成两个 7 位:
SET packet: command byte 0xD3 + start channel + count + each value split into two 7-bit bytes.
39 bytes @115200 baud ≈ 3.4 ms; must be sent in a single write (the firmware's per-byte timeout is only 100 µs).
Servo2040 收到后,把 18 路 PWM 引脚的脉宽寄存器一改,硬件持续: On receipt the Servo2040 updates the pulse-width registers of its 18 PWM pins, and the hardware keeps outputting. Each servo gets its own pulse and its internal potentiometer + motor loop turns it to the target angle. The two 50 Hz values are a coincidence and independent: the 50 Hz control loop is the software tick, the 50 Hz PWM is the servo signal standard.
<b>全链路最重要的一个坑:开环。</b>\n舵机没有位置回读——树莓派只知道\: The most important pitfall of the whole chain: open loop. Servos have no position read-back — the Pi only knows "the pulse width was sent", not whether the joint actually turned there. Under load, backlash + structural compliance let the actual angle drift, and the foot ends up several millimeters off: that is the physical root of the 08-19 video, where the press reaction bent the stance leg chains 13–27 mm, and of the nominal 13 mm press_delta only pressing in a few millimeters and having to be deepened to 18. Every "measure and back-fill" and "criteria on pressure/current, not commanded position" practice in the code is a way around this blind spot. (The pneumatic side does have feedback: cup pressure sensor → −30 kPa attachment criterion → only then dare to lift the next leg. Motion is open loop, adhesion is closed loop, and the safety of climbing rests entirely on the latter.)

<b>电源架构</b>：2S 直供舵机 / 独立 5V 5A 给 Pi（绝不共轨: Power architecture: 2S direct to the servos / separate 5 V 5 A for the Pi (never a shared rail; a stalled-servo dip reboots the Pi) / boost to 12 V for pump and valves
<b>开关器件</b>：MOSFET 板、光耦隔离、感性负载续流二极管；继电器必: Switching devices: MOSFET board, optocoupler isolation, flyback diodes for inductive loads; the relay must switch the positive high side — ground is shared with the Pi through USB, so a low-side switch would be bypassed
<b>模拟链路</b>：4.5V 传感器要分压进 3.3V 系统，ADS1115: Analog chain: 4.5 V sensors divided into a 3.3 V system, ADS1115 single-ended channels, PGA range, polling the conversion-ready bit, two-point calibration giving kPa = 25 × (V − V_atm)
<b>电源完整性</b>：欠压历史标志、瞬态余量、USB 口选择都能让系统在半空: Power integrity: undervoltage history flags, transient margin and USB port choice can all reboot the system mid-air; check the power first, suspect the logic later
<b>噪声判读</b>：读数瞬断先做频谱——工频占比小就是静电耦合，不是接触不良: Reading noise: on reading dropouts, take a spectrum first — a small mains-frequency share means electrostatic coupling, not a bad contact

50Hz 主环里要塞进 18 路舵机指令 + 7 路 I2C 压力读数，不做限流: The 50 Hz main loop must fit 18 servo commands + 7 I2C pressure reads; without rate limiting it jitters periodically — the read cache and burst limiting in adhesion.py exist for this.
<b>协议实现</b>：串口按固件源码逐字节对，14 位值拆成两个 7 位；包头: Protocol implementation: match the serial protocol byte by byte against the firmware source, 14-bit values split into two 7-bit bytes; header checks, no split writes
<b>时间预算</b>：传感器读数最坏陈旧 0.11s，所以判据的确认窗必须显著: Time budget: sensor readings are at worst 0.11 s stale, so a criterion's confirmation window must be clearly longer than that, or the window cannot span two real samples
<b>状态机与互锁</b>：吸附六态、腿相位十段、抬腿前其余五足必须全部吸牢: State machines and interlocks: six adhesion states, ten leg phases, the other five feet must all be attached before a lift
<b>防毛刺</b>：判据用\"条件连续成立一段时间\"而不是\"连续 N 次\: Glitch rejection: criteria use "condition holds continuously for a duration", not "N consecutive samples" — independent of sample rate
<b>硬件抽象 + Mock</b>：没有硬件也能跑完整逻辑和 81 项测试，这: Hardware abstraction + mocks: the full logic and all 81 tests run without hardware; this is what makes remote development possible
<b>黑匣子日志</b>：行缓冲加周期 fsync，写盘失败只告警不炸控制环——: Black-box logging: line buffering plus periodic fsync; a failed write only warns and never crashes the control loop — both later quantified reports depended on it
控制观（本项目没有 PID）: The control view (this project has no PID)
18 个 PWM 舵机：没有位置回读、没有力矩模式、没有单路使能。能做的只有一件: 18 PWM servos: no position read-back, no torque mode, no per-channel enable. The only thing you can do is send position commands.
<b>改指令 = 改力</b>：吸住的脚不能滑，所以位置指令的增量实际上是在重新: Changing the command = changing the force: an attached foot cannot slip, so an increment in position command actually redistributes load — the whole principle behind the "zero-force handover"
<b>电流是力的间接观测</b>：吸附后总电流不回落，就说明舵机在和真空对抗；逐: Current is an indirect observation of force: if total current does not fall back after attachment, the servos are fighting the vacuum; a cycle-by-cycle climb is internal stress accumulating
<b>准静态</b>：交接和倾身都按 10mm/s 匀速铺，慢到可以忽略动力学: Quasi-static: handover and lean are applied at a constant 10 mm/s, slow enough to ignore dynamics
<b>什么时候不该上闭环</b>：传感器精度、执行器带宽都不支持时，开环加互锁加: When not to close the loop: when neither sensor precision nor actuator bandwidth supports it, open loop plus interlocks plus timeout freeze is more reliable than a forced feedback loop

<b>测法设计</b>：高差法（<code>sinα = Δh/l</code>: Measurement design: height-difference method (sinα = Δh/l), three-side method (law of cosines), projection method — pick one that is reproducible and immune to lateral offset
<b>误差传播</b>：姿态接近竖直时正弦变平，1mm 读数误差会放大成 4.5: Error propagation: near vertical the sine flattens and a 1 mm reading error becomes 4.5° — so the calibration pose must be chosen, not arbitrary
<b>基准定义比测量本身更重要</b>：膝轴在哪、足端在哪、吸盘轴是哪条线——三: Defining the reference matters more than measuring: where the knee axis is, where the foot is, which line is the cup axis — all three were once defined wrong, and all three were corrected only by cross-examining three-view drawings
<b>状态相关几何</b>：吸盘自由态高 19mm、压密封 7.5mm、抽真空: State-dependent geometry: the cup is 19 mm tall free, 7.5 mm pressed to seal, 8 mm under vacuum — hence "press to seal first, then pump"; pumping barely moves it
<code>logs_analysis/ab_quant.py</code>：视: logs_analysis/ab_quant.py: frame-by-frame NCC template matching + parabolic sub-pixel + static-reference camera-drift correction, splitting each round's 74 mm of slip by event.
<b>量化优先于调参</b>：没有这次逐帧量化，\"83% 在密封破裂瞬间\"永: Quantify before tuning: without this frame-by-frame quantification, "83% at the seal-rupture instant" would never have been found, only endless blind tuning of compensation coefficients
<b>视频测位移</b>：模板匹配、亚像素插值、mm/px 标定、参照物去相机漂: Measuring displacement from video: template matching, sub-pixel interpolation, mm/px calibration, static reference to remove camera drift
<b>A/B 对照的纪律</b>：当日重跑基线、相机三脚架变焦锁死、首轮前打对时: A/B discipline: re-run the baseline the same day, tripod and zoom locked, sync marker before the first round, always judge on round 2 (round 1 is the transient ramp from zero)
<b>敢用数据否决自己的方案</b>：慢放气这个\"看起来很合理\"的想法，就是: Dare to let data reject your own idea: slow venting, an idea that "sounded reasonable", was shot down on the spot by the profile data

<b>验收判据要可量化</b>：50 次循环 &gt;95%、1.5kg 挂 5: Acceptance criteria must be quantifiable: 50 cycles >95%, 1.5 kg hanging for 5 minutes, slip per round <10 mm — not "feels fine"

D · 书上不会讲的六条: D · Six things the books will not tell you
这些是这个项目自己撞出来的。每一条都花了至少一整天，有几条花了四天。: These were hit by this project itself. Each cost at least a full day, several cost four.
一 · 三自由度腿的位置和朝向是绑死的: One · On a 3-DOF leg, position and orientation are locked together
吸盘要压得密封，轴线得基本垂直墙面；但腿只有三个关节，落点一定，吸盘朝向就定了，:
For the cup to seal, its axis must be roughly perpendicular to the wall; but the leg has only three joints, so once the foothold is chosen the cup direction is fixed, with no fourth degree of freedom to compensate.
      As a result, stand height 90 mm, stance reach 176 mm, stride ≤40 mm are not comfortable tuned values
      but hard constraints solved backward from "bellows cup ±15° tolerance". The general floor pose reach=130 moved onto the wall makes the cup meet the surface at 16.7° and simply not seal.
二 · \"常闭阀\"标称靠不住，断电保压要靠接法凑出来: Two · A "normally closed valve" label cannot be trusted; vacuum hold on power loss has to be assembled from the wiring
买到的三通阀断电时是出气口通大气——照标称接，一断电全机就掉。\n 实: The 3-way valves bought vent the outlet to air when unpowered — wired by the label, the whole robot drops at the first power loss. The actual fix is reversing the tubing: when unpowered the cup stays connected to the stopped diaphragm pump, whose internal check valves lock the vacuum. A free bonus comes with it: while attached at rest the coils are unpowered, six valves at zero power. A component's real behavior must be tested by blowing through it yourself; do not trust the listing.
三 · 抬腿的弹性势能，会在密封破裂那一瞬把整机拽下去: Three · The elastic energy of a lifted leg drags the whole robot down at the instant the seal ruptures
在平地上机器人是可以往前走的，但在玻璃墙上似乎一直是原地踏步……每次它抬起一条腿:
On flat ground the robot can walk forward, but on the glass wall it seems to march in place all the time… every time it lifts a leg it gets dragged down a bit.
      <cite>project log · the day of the first wall climb</cite>
如果抬起腿的弹性势能比较大，抬起腿把势能释放掉了，整个身体反而往下移动了一段距离:
If the lifted leg's elastic energy is large, lifting it releases that energy and the whole body moves down a distance instead; I found that this is what keeps it from advancing.
      <cite>project log · root cause spotted four days later, confirmed by data the next day</cite>
逐帧量化结果：阀开后 0.4s 泄压期身体位移 &lt;0.15mm，密封破裂后: Frame-by-frame quantification: during the 0.4 s of venting after the valve opens the body moves <0.15 mm; after the seal ruptures the drop completes in 1–2 frames (<100 ms), single-leg bounces from 5.8 to 20.9 mm (a fourfold spread between legs), and total current ratchets up every cycle without falling back. The cure is not slow venting (rejected by the data) but handing the load over before venting.
四 · 位置控制的执行器，也能做力的重分配: Four · Position-controlled actuators can still redistribute force
吸住的脚不能滑，所以给它的位置指令改变的其实是力。\n 被抬那条腿的指:
An attached foot cannot slip, so the position command you give it actually changes force.
      The leg to be lifted has its command retreat "uphill" by δ to unload itself, and the other five each take δ/5 "downhill" — the vector sum of the six commands is zero, the body command does not move,
      but that leg's force drops to near zero and there is no energy to release when the seal breaks. This idea holds even on servos with no torque interface; it is the most elegant step of the project.
五 · 电源问题伪装成一切别的问题: Five · Power problems disguise themselves as everything else
树莓派红灯不启动、拔光接口仍红灯、万用表量到 0V——排查了一上午 MOSFET: Raspberry Pi red LED, no boot, still red with every connector pulled, multimeter reading 0 V — a whole morning checking the MOSFET board channel by channel for breakdown, fixed in the end by swapping a phone charger; the board was never broken. The same week: the servo board reported undervoltage on the blue USB 3.0 port and was fine on the black USB 2.0 port. The order should be reversed: swap the power supply first, look at the undervoltage flag first, suspect logic and parts later.
六 · 几何真值不是量出来的，是先定义再量的: Six · Geometric truth is not measured, it is defined first and then measured
\"小腿多长\"这个问题吵了一整天，根子不在测量精度，在三个基准点没定义清楚：膝: The question "how long is the tibia" was argued for a whole day, and the root was not measurement precision but three undefined reference points: where the knee axis is, where the foot ends, which line is the cup axis. It converged only by drawing three views and cross-examining them (tibia_len = 123.7; the official value is 134). And the cup axis is not "the line from knee to lip center" at all; the two differ by 25.2° — an error that at one point made the whole "stand perpendicular" implementation wrong. Cross-examining drawings is the most effective way to resolve a disagreement, far cheaper than arguing on.

时间上，本项目从单腿验收到首次上墙、再到定位并解决\"原地踏步\"，是一个月的密:
In time, this project went from single-leg acceptance to the first wall climb and on to locating and solving "stepping in place" in one month of intensive development (166 commits).
    Less than a week of that went into kinematics and gait; the rest went into calibration, pneumatics, power and quantified experiments.
<b>减配建议</b>：只想学机器人，做地面六足就够，省掉整个第三组的知识和一半: Cut-down advice: if you only want to learn robotics, a floor hexapod is enough and saves the whole of group III and half the money; if you want to play with climbing without building the whole robot, a single-leg rig for a few hundred yuan meets all the most interesting physics (sealing, peeling, elasticity). Cut-downs not recommended: dropping the pressure sensors for timed valves — without pressure feedback the state machine cannot tell "attached or not", and going on the wall becomes luck; dropping the black-box log — after an incident nothing can be traced.
看起来最\"高门槛\"的那部分——运动学、步态、机器人控制——恰恰是最标准化、最:
The part that looks most "high-barrier" — kinematics, gait, robot control — is exactly the most standardized and easiest to copy.
      The leg inverse solution is 52 lines, the gait engine 102, the structure has a complete MIT-licensed open-source design, the servo board has ready-made firmware.
      Someone who writes Python and knows trigonometry can get a hexapod walking on the floor within two weeks.
这个项目里三次真正的破局——小腿长度纠偏、欠压规律定位、弹性势能根因——\n: The three real breakthroughs of this project — correcting the tibia length, pinning down the undervoltage pattern, the elastic-energy root cause — came not from smarter analysis but from using physical photos, multimeter readings and frame-by-frame video to push back a plausible-sounding wrong assumption. Whether you are willing to do that decides whether you finish it, more than whether you can solve inverse kinematics.

跨天规律与复盘: Patterns across the days, and the retrospective
What the three breakthroughs have in common: the tibia three-view correction (08-07), the USB3.0 undervoltage pattern (08-16), the elastic-energy root cause (08-19) — all of them are the user pushing the AI's wrong assumption back with a photo of the real part or with a measurement, not something obtained by asking more questions. Confronting it with a drawing (a three-view, a schematic HTML) is the most effective way to resolve a disagreement about the facts; the gait-to-servo explainer page of 08-19 belongs to the same pattern — first fill the gap in understanding, then judge whether the AI's analysis is right.
